experiences.description:
As Chief Product Officer and Co-Founder of Delectable AI, I architect the intelligence layer revolutionizing grocery commerce through agentic AI that unifies computational gastronomy, precision nutrition, and real-time retail context. Under my leadership, Delectable AI is pioneering unified intelligence that connects shopper preferences, household needs, and health requirements across the entire grocery value chain.
I set the product vision and lead engineering execution, drawing on 25 years at the forefront of applied AI for eCommerce. I've been in the center of every major wave of AI adoption in commerce—from early applications of rule-based personalization and collaborative filtering at ATG, to neural network-powered recommendations and seach at Reflektion, from rules based search at Endeca to semantic vector search and GenAI at Lucidworks.  I've worked with hundreds of retailers across all formats—from enterprise chains to regional grocers—implementing AI that drives measurable business outcomes.
At the heart of Delectable AI's platform is a shared intelligence layer—spanning product, shopper, pantry, dietary, household, cuisine, flavor, region, meal, and budget intelligence—powered by specialized agents that work in concert. For consumers, we deliver an AI teammate that shoulders the mental load of managing dietary restrictions, preferences, and wellness goals. For retailers of all sizes, we drive engagement, basket growth, and new retail media revenue without infrastructure overhaul. For CPG brands, we provide precision targeting at the moment of inspiration.
This mission is deeply personal. For 15 years, I've navigated complex dietary management as a primary household shopper and cook, experiencing firsthand the burden millions face daily when health, preferences, and constraints collide with grocery decisions.
I'm building Delectable AI to prove the smartest technology in the store can be on your side.
